Perusahaan masih merugi (EPS 12 bulan terakhir negatif).
Simulasi: 53% kemungkinan harga turun >20% dalam 12 bulan (volatilitas 106%/thn).

pros.text: Estimasi nilai wajar $48.90 vs harga $24.45 — potensi naik 100% (rentang $31–$74).

Diuntungkan tema geopolitik Reshoring & Kebijakan Industri AS (intensitas 46/100): Insentif membangun pabrik di AS (chip, energi, infrastruktur, data center) menguntungkan industri peralatan listrik, konstruksi, dan bahan bangunan..
Tahan guncangan geopolitik: eksposur rendah terhadap tarif, konflik, dan rantai pasok global (skor ketahanan 71/100).

summary: Oklo Inc. develops fission power plants to provide energy at scale to customers in the United States. The company offers Aurora Powerhouse, which is designed to produce between 15 and up to 75 megawatts of electricity. It is also commercializing nuclear fuel recycling and fuel fabrication technology that can convert used nuclear fuel into usable fuel for its reactors. The company was formerly known as AltC Acquisition Corp. and changed its name to Oklo Inc. in May 2024. Oklo Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
thesis: Oklo Inc. memiliki fundamental sangat lemah (skor 25/100) dengan keunggulan utama di kesehatan keuangan (56) dan pertumbuhan (40). Titik lemahnya ada di kualitas bisnis (6). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $48.90 — potensi naik 100.0% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal sangat lemah (25/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah; berpeluang diuntungkan tema Reshoring & Kebijakan Industri AS.
